{"id":"agora-hj1c","title":"Profile: DIDComm ciphertext translator (IO)","description":"Write a non-normative profile for an IO-side translator that carries Agora MLS ciphertext to MLS-capable DIDComm wallets without decrypting.

Scope:
- Map envelopes, Subscribe, and channel tokens onto DIDComm messages; the translator subscribes to relays on the wallet's behalf.
- Add a ServiceAgreement serviceType for the translator.
- Add an ARCHITECTURE §5 observation-budget entry (tokens carried, DIDComm endpoint, timing; comparable to a push proxy).
- Decide whether the wallet's own DIDComm mediator is treated as the user's network choice and kept outside Agora's observation budget (needs Mark's decision).
- KeyPackage and Welcome delivery stay on HTTPS KeyPackageEndpoint (dtg-openvtc.md §8 unchanged).

Rejected alternative: treating DIDComm mediators as relays (Agora cannot bind mediators it does not run). A plaintext DIDComm gateway remains possible under spec §9 / profiles/gateways.md for wallets without MLS.

{"description":"Approved design (Mark 2026-10-31): mirror the push-proxy model.
- New serviceType wallet-transport. Relay-designated translator (relay manifest, agreement with the relay) or CO-designated (Space state walletTransport, agreement with the CO, receives only that CO's channel tokens).
- Translator carries live-stream messages (spec 11.4) over DIDComm v2 or TSP unchanged; wallet signs every Publish; translator holds no keys, plaintext, or membership.
- KeyPackages/Welcomes stay on HTTPS KeyPackageEndpoint; history stays on relay sync API.
- Wallet SHOULD use a pairwise DID per translator (not MUST); budget entry states the linkage if it does not.
- Wallet's own mediator = user's network, outside budget, accepted limit.

new_value: Specified as core spec/11-transport.md §11.9 Wallet Transport (not a profile: it defines protocol). serviceType wallet-transport; relay-designated (manifest walletTransport, capability wallet-transport-v1, agreement with each CO holding a relay agreement) or CO-designated (Space state walletTransport). WTOpen/WTFrame/WTClose over DIDComm v2 (type urn:agora:type:WalletTransport) or TSP; WebSocket upstream; seq ordering incl. close; wallet transport answers AdmissionChallenge; no PushRegister through it; connectionLogRetentionDays binds all carried traffic. Pairwise DID MUST (Mark 2026-10-31, changed from SHOULD after review: S1/§11.6). Mediator = user's network. Limits recorded: forged relay messages (confirm failover Errors directly), per-address throttling, connection count. ARCHITECTURE 2.3 row, 5 item 10, 6.1; 03-spaces, 10-relays, 99-appendices, dtg-openvtc 9 updated. Pre-existing gap not fixed: pushProxy/walletTransport absent from 10.2.1 manifest schema.
